decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording green dispense buttons and beige button lettering, so no additional or corrected Event is required.
Selecting beige lettering for the dispense buttons does not change the DJ turntable-inspired visual theme.
The source concerns the cursive K on dispense buttons, not the machine placard text, faces, or placement.
The color of the dispense-button marking does not alter the dedicated master power control or its placement.
The button-lettering color has no effect on bowl capacity, form, or compactness constraints.
The source changes only button branding color and leaves solenoid actuation, valve behavior, and dispensing isolation unchanged.
The source does not change spout removability, bowl cleaning, or whisk-detachment requirements.
The button-marking color decision does not modify the BOM deliverable or its approval state.
The source does not change the required CAD or finalized system-layout deliverable.
The dispense-button lettering color does not affect enclosure size, profile, or accommodation of deep bowl wells.
The visual color decision does not change the electrical wiring-plan deliverable.
The color of the button marking has no effect on smoothness, froth quality, or high-speed mixing behavior.
